annotations.title: Get the recalls of a device

description: List the U.S. FDA recalls linked to one device by slug: recall number, FDA recall class (I, II or III), status (ongoing, completed or terminated), start date, reason, and whether the recall names this device or only its shared 510(k) or PMA submission. Optional status filter; newest first, at most 100. Use when the question is about recalls or field safety actions of a known device. Do not use for recalls across devices, by product, firm or date (use search_recalls), for the whole record (use get_device with detail=full) or to find the device (use search_devices). EU devices without an FDA record have no recall data. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

slug.description: Device slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/devices/<slug> URL, as returned by search_devices or find_device_by_identifier. A full page URL or a device:<slug> id is accepted. e.g. heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028

status.description: Only recalls with this FDA status: ongoing, completed or terminated. Default: all.

name: get_device_recalls
